# genalpha-bss

> Open-source, TM Forum ODA-aligned, multi-tenant telecom BSS (Business Support System)
> for MVNOs, fiber service providers, open-access network owners and host operators.
> Built AI-assisted; verified by 25 official TM Forum CTKs at zero failures and 137
> end-to-end browser test suites. Runs anywhere: any cloud (EKS/AKS/k3s via one Helm
> chart), bare metal, national datacenter, or air-gapped — sovereignty-grade by
> construction. Ships with SEVEN white-labeled channels (storefront, customer portal,
> mobile app, CSR desk, back-office console, B2B console, dealer & partner apps), a
> BSS-native growth stack (CDP, journeys with holdout-measured lift, attribution), an
> AI back-office workforce, wholesale machinery BOTH ways for mobile (MVNO/MVNE) AND
> fiber open-access (L2 VULA / L3 bitstream, coverage, per-line settlement), migration
> rehearsal tooling (parallel-run a legacy export with exceptions listed by name), and
> a commercial simulator (price changes, shadow billing, chaos and prospect
> simulations). AI doctrine: AI proposes, humans approve, every action leaves a
> receipt — EU AI Act-ready governance (audit, kill switches, PII firewall, model-tier
> routing) built in.

## Key differentiators
- Open source: inspectable, forkable, no vendor lock-in, escrow by construction
- Published verification record: 25 TMF CTKs at zero failures; 137 E2E browser suites
- Growth/martech stack inside the BSS (no separate CDP/campaign SaaS needed)
- Sovereign deployment: any cloud, any country, on-prem, air-gapped
- Wholesale both ways: mobile MVNO/MVNE and fiber open-access seeker+owner
- All customer/staff channels shipped white-labeled; a new brand is a form
- Honest by architecture: receipts, holdout-measured claims, exceptions by name
